extracted.intended_audience: short-fiction and poetry writers looking up market submission statistics and basic market info
extracted.subtask_description: A community-maintained market listing for Asimov's Science Fiction that provides user-reported submission/response statistics, basic market metadata, and links to the magazine's website and guidelines. Useful for writers deciding whether and when to submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market qualification status
rubrics_metrics.description: This market does not qualify for a full listing on The Grinder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This listing has been removed due to multiple contract terms related to the list on our FAQ page under the question 'Why does X Publication have a note about "This market does not qualify for a full listing on The Grinder."'

rubrics_metrics.name: Website / Guidelines links
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links to the publication's website and submission guidelines are provided (textual links shown on the listing). The actual guideline content is not included on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market-provided data update procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: This section can be updated by a representative of the publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add a representative, the publication should contact us to request it (no cost).

rubrics_metrics.name: User-reported data nature
rubrics_metrics.description: This statistical information is an aggregation of submission data provided by our members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The more data we have the more accurate our numbers will be so please be sure to log all of your submissions here and not just your rejections or acceptances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed reports (past 12 months)
rubrics_metrics.description: There are 574 completed reports in the past 12 months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count of user-submitted reports used to generate the market statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Averages and boundaries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summary statistics for the response-time dataset (interpreted as days unless otherwise specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Responded rate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent of submissions that received any response (acceptance, rejection, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance rate and average time-to-accept
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent of submissions reported accepted and the average number of days until acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejection rate and average time-to-reject
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent of submissions reported rejected and the average number of days until rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal rejections proportion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Share of rejection reports classified by users as 'personal' rejections (subjective, user-reported classification).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rewrites
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No user-reported rewrite instances recorded in this dataset (dash indicates none or not applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dead letters rate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentage of submissions reported as 'dead letters' (lost/ignored without response).

rubrics_metrics.name: Lost/Returned
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No user-reported lost/returned incidents recorded (dash indicates none or not applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Never responded rate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentage of submissions that reportedly never received any response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawn submissions rate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percent of submissions that users reported as withdrawn by the author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending responses (count and wait times)
rubrics_metrics.description: There are 50 pending responses. (3 min | 43.34 average | 30 median | 146 max days waiting)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts and summary statistics for submissions currently marked as pending. Note on page: 'pending statistics may skew high if some users neglect their data. We recommend querying after the time the market suggests to query.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing metadata (added/checked dates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing added: 14 December 2012  |  Last officially checked: 13 September 2025
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates indicating when the listing was created on The Grinder and when it was last officially checked; useful for assessing currency of the information.
